description: 1125 K Phase 2 DRC about the inflation root (lambda 1.0): all 20 directions (16 reactions + 4 sticking coefficients), +-0.3 e-folds, 144 CRN-paired replicates. 0.3 not 0.9: at lambda 1 the growth rate roughly triples per e-fold and lambda 0.5 no longer reaches 200 A, so a 0.9 step would leave the growing regime.
